title: P0.32: Governed User Chrome Bridge / External Session Selection
description: Closes the root-cause blocker: IABV uses an isolated browser profile (chatgpt_program_session) while the user is logged into their normal Chrome. This blocks external consultation because IABV cannot access the user's authenticated session. P0.32 adds a governed bridge with explicit permission, CDP detection, and manual fallback.
resume_hint: Implementation complete and loaded in the Windows runtime. P0.33 follow-up removed the PowerShell/command handoff and corrected the bridge model: IABV must not attach to the user's normal Chrome profile. It now launches a governed persistent bridge profile from the UI when the user types 'abrir chrome con puente'.
next_action: User types 'abrir chrome con puente'. If ChatGPT requests login in that bridge window, the user logs in there once. Then type 'usar mi chrome' and retry the ChatGPT consultation. If CDP remains unavailable, keep manual pasteback and inspect runtime_audit user_browser_bridge events.
